scope: First five top-level events in EVENTS array, preserving app order

events.name: La Corsa della Bora
events.evidence: Official route pages state that the final 2027 GPX is released in the week before the race; earlier tracks may be unsafe/outdated and parts cross private land.
events.followUp: Recheck in race week; do not substitute historic tracks.

events.name: Marathon de Sables
events.evidence: Current official 2027 event page describes the 100 km and 100-mile formats but no GPX download was found.
events.followUp: Recheck the official event page and participant material closer to the event.

events.name: Arc of Attrition by UTMB
events.evidence: The official Arc 100M page has a Map + GPX section. No direct downloadable file URL was extracted; the Arc 100K page could not be loaded by the web reader.
events.followUp: Inspect the official map/GPX section manually or recheck page availability.

events.name: Mountain Man Winter
events.gpxStatus: not-downloadable-yet for 12h/6h; other two route names not verified
events.evidence: Official website and 2027 PDF confirm a 7.5 km / approx. 110 m loop and say the GPX download will be provided before the event. App's M-Trail and L-Trail labels are not in the current official Winterloop 2027 race list.
events.followUp: Recheck official download publication; separately reconcile M-Trail/L-Trail route assignment.

events.name: Ultra Mediterrania
events.evidence: The official website's TRACK link redirects to a Google Drive folder described as Track All Distances - GPX. The folder view could not be read in the available browser, so individual file names and direct download URLs remain unverified.
events.followUp: Open official folder, identify 160K file, verify track and add the direct GPX file.

dataQualityFlags: Main EVENTS array has stale 2026 dates for Marathon de Sables, Arc of Attrition and Mountain Man Winter; event-dates.json contains verified 2027 dates. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.

Official Corsa della Bora 2027 page differs from some app distance/elevation values: Borderless 35.8 km / 787 m, Half Trail 23 km / 693 m, Family Hike 14.5 km / 413 m, Borin 4 km / approx. 100 m. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.
Official MDS 2027 page describes 100 km / approx. 580 m and 100 miles / approx. 875 m; app route metrics differ. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.
